content: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED only protects the claiming SELECT; it was never designed to serialize reads of unrelated rows. If a worker crashes after claiming (locking) a row but before committing a status update in the same transaction, the row becomes a 'zombie' — invisible to other workers until the holding connection/transaction ends. Recommendation: update job status in the SAME transaction as the claim; consider pg_advisory_xact_lock for serializing claim contention.
